name: batch8
rows: large silver-chrome semi-automatic pistol with a heavy slide that has slanted grooves at the rear, a long flat top, a ventilated muzzle with a front sight at the end, a rail under the barrel, a black rubber grip and a trigger guard. No text.

black bullpup sniper rifle: a thick black cylindrical suppressor at the front, a slim black body with the magazine behind the pistol grip, a short skeletal butt at the rear, and a small folding bipod hanging under the front. No scope.

revolver-rifle: a black revolver cylinder in the middle of a long slim black barrel with a rail on top, a walnut wooden stock with a rubber butt pad, a wooden fore-end below the barrel, a trigger below the cylinder, and a front sight.

black AK-style shotgun: a black folding stock with an angled strut, a black receiver with a rail on top, a black handguard with vertical grooves, a black pistol grip, a long thin barrel with a muzzle end, and a long curved black box magazine.
